resources.string: List cards now display a clean, mathematical breakdown of [Budget] - [Expenses] = [Balance] with zero-decimals removed!
Need to fix a typo? You can now quickly rename any list simply by long-pressing its card on the dashboard.
Custom layouts are now permanently saved! Manually drag and drop your records and we\'ll remember your layout.
The dashboard balances now update instantly. Plus, new asymmetric buttons and unified theme colors.
Fixed attachment bugs, smart timestamps only update on actual changes, and swipe-to-delete selection conflicts resolved.
